info.name: Public Content Service - Content (type: showcase)
info.description:
Sample requests/responses untuk konten dengan type 'showcase' pada public-content-service.

Endpoints:
1. GET /api/content - Index content (list showcase, content type = 'showcase')
2. GET /api/content/showcase - Detail showcase

Base URL local dev: http://localhost:4076/public-content-service/api

query.description: required | in:menu,sub_menu,child_sub_menu - level menu tempat konten berada
required | array - slug menu per level (urutan sesuai type)
